passages/ea47-a: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Alfie's aunt told him a tale about the wild haggis. \"It has short legs on one side and long legs on the other,\" she said, \"so it can run round a hill.\" Alfie packed a basket and a map and set off to find one. He searched the grass and the rocks for half the afternoon. At last he sat down, calm but cross. Then his aunt began to laugh. \"There is no wild haggis!\" she said. Alfie had to laugh too. That night they had haggis for tea, and it was fantastic."]

passages/ea47-ay: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "On the eighth day of the holidays, it began to snow. Jay and Kate raced to the shed to get the old sleigh. They waited on the hill while their neighbour Dave made a straight track. \"Are you afraid?\" asked Kate. \"No way!\" said Jay. passages/ea47-b: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Bob is a builder. Last week he had to build a cupboard for a big library. He grabbed his tools and a box of bolts. passages/ea47-d: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Doodle the dog loved puddles. One day he dashed into the biggest puddle in the park and landed with a splash. passages/ea47-ee: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Every week, Neve and Eve cycled to a secret beach. It was the perfect place to read and eat their sweets in peace. passages/ea47-f: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Phil wanted a photograph of an elephant for his school project. He went to the safari park with his sister Fiona. passages/ea47-g: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Our guide at the castle was called Greg. He had a big grin and a gold guitar. \"Guess what?\" he said. \"This castle has a ghost.\" We all giggled. passages/ea47-i: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "In a busy little village, things kept going missing. First a gift, then a crystal vase, then a big bag of biscuits. The villagers were puzzled. passages/ea47-j: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "At the edge of our village, there is a giant hedge shaped like a dragon. Every June, the judges come to see it. passages/ea47-kw: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Queen Quinn was very quiet. She would never shout or quarrel. One night, a squirrel squeezed into the palace and began to squeak. It ran up the curtains and quickly ate her quiche. The guards began to squabble about how to catch it. The queen just sat still. Then she put a square of cheese on the floor. The squirrel crept over, and Queen Quinn quietly put a quilt over it. She carried it outside and let it go. \"Quick thinking is better than quarrelling,\" she said."]

passages/ea47-le: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "A little squirrel lived in a tunnel under an old castle. Every morning it would nibble seeds and acorns on the castle wall. One day a gentle girl called Isabel left an apple and a handful of nuts on a metal table. The squirrel began to travel closer and closer. At first it was nervous and gave a little tremble. Then it grabbed a nut and scuttled off. By the end of the summer, the squirrel would eat out of Isabel's hand. It was the most special animal she had ever met."]

passages/ea47-m: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Mum and I like to climb hills. In the autumn, we climbed the tallest mountain in the area. My thumbs were numb with cold, and my legs ached. We stopped for a crumb of cake and some warm milk. At the top there was a column of stones, called a cairn. We added a stone to it. The view was amazing: lochs, lambs and miles of moorland. On the way down, we hummed a hymn we learned in school. It was a magical day."]

passages/ea47-n: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "A young knight named Nina knelt before the king. \"I need a knife for my journey,\" she said. The king gave her a knife with a gold handle and a sign of a lion on it. Nina rode for nine days through snow and rain. At night she sat by the fire and knitted. On the tenth day she met a gnome who had lost his way. She used her new knife to cut a path through the brambles, and led him home. The king said she was the kindest knight he had ever known."]

passages/ea47-ng: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Long ago, a strong king lived in a jungle. He could lift anything with one finger. One day, he sang a song so long that the monkeys began to yawn. A young penguin wandered in and said, \"Thank you for the song, but I think it is time to sleep.\" The king was angry at first. Then he began to think. He was singing too much and not listening! From then on, the king sang just one song each evening, and everyone in the jungle had a long sleep."]

passages/ea47-o: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Polly was the naughty daughter of a farmer. One autumn morning, she wanted to watch the swans on the pond. She was not allowed to go alone, but she sneaked off anyway. She crawled under the fence and fell into the pond with a splash. A swan began to squawk. Her dad heard the noise and ran to help. He caught her coat and pulled her out. Polly was cold and soggy. \"I ought to have asked,\" she said. Her dad taught her a lesson she would not forget."]

passages/ea47-oa: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Joe and his grandad own an old boat called Goldie. It has a yellow stripe and a hole in the floor. On a cold morning they rowed out to the island to toast marshmallows. The sea was smooth and slow. But then water began to flow in through the hole! Joe used his old coat to plug it, and they rowed home as fast as they could. Grandad laughed so much that his nose glowed. \"We will fix Goldie tomorrow,\" he said, \"though I know you will not want to row again.\""]

passages/ea47-oi: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Roy got a royal robot toy for his birthday. It could point, join in songs and make the loudest noise you can imagine. At first everyone enjoyed it. But soon the noise began to annoy the whole family. \"Avoid pressing the big button!\" said Mum. Roy did not listen. The robot made such a noise that the dog hid in the coil of the hose. In the end, Roy made a choice. He took out the batteries and enjoyed a quiet game of quoits instead."]

passages/ea47-oo: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Ruth could play a few tunes on her new flute. One afternoon she took it to the zoo. As she blew a cool tune, the animals began to move. The kangaroos hopped in time, a group of baboons danced in a loop, and a goose flew down to listen. A crowd grew around her. \"Who knew a flute could do that?\" said a boy. The zoo keeper gave Ruth a juicy fruit smoothie and asked her to play again soon."]

passages/ea47-ow: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "High on the mountain, Howard and Rowan pitched their tent beside a fountain of water. Around midnight, a loud howl woke them. passages/ea47-r: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Ruby wanted to wrap a present for her brother Rory. She wrapped a red rubber ball in shiny paper and wrote his name on the tag. But in a rush she wrote the wrong name. She wrote Rex, the name of their dog! On Rory's birthday, Rex ripped open the parcel and ran off with the ball. Rory started to frown. passages/ea47-s: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Our class visited a castle on a cliff. Inside, the guide said the castle was haunted by a sad soldier with a sword. Sam said there was no such thing, and that science could explain any noise. That night, we stayed in sleeping bags in the great hall. Suddenly, we heard a whistle and a hiss. Sam was the first to listen. He found that the wind was whistling through a gap in the castle wall. The guide smiled. \"So the soldier was the wind all along,\" she said."]

passages/ea47-sh: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Shona went to a special show by a famous magician. He wore a shiny shirt and a long dark cape. passages/ea47-th: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "On Thursday, our class went to the theatre to see a play about a thief. In the third act, there was a crash of thunder. My brother thought it was real and grabbed my arm. Then the thief tumbled through the curtains and landed in the front row! Everyone thought it was part of the play. It was not. The actor had tripped on a thick rope. He was fine, though. He thanked the audience, then climbed back on stage, and the play went on."]

passages/ea47-u: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "My cousin Gus has a young puppy called Bun. Bun loves to run and jump about. Last month, Bun dug up the whole garden and buried Gus's brother's football. Then a huge thunderstorm came and the rain began to flood the lawn. Bun was covered in mud from his tummy to his tail. My cousin wondered what to do. In the end he scrubbed Bun in the tub until he was clean. Bun just wanted another run in the mud. That pup is double trouble!"]

passages/ea47-v: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Seven sheep live on Vicky's farm. One evening, the oldest sheep, Vera, would not move. Vicky gave her water and some leaves, but she would not eat. passages/ea47-wh: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Which animal can whistle? A whale can! When Whitney visited the white cliffs, she heard a strange whistle out at sea. Then a whale's tail flicked out of the water. Whitney grabbed her mum's sleeve. \"Where did it go?\" she whispered. The whale blew water into the air with a whoosh. passages/ea47-yoo: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "In the middle of our town there is a beautiful statue of a unicorn. A few weeks ago, someone painted it blue for a joke. The town was furious. passages/ea47-z: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "Zara plays the saxophone in a jazz band. One summer, the band was asked to play at the zoo. The zebras were the first to hear the music. passages/puppy: ["pocket-tts", "eponine", 200, "On the way home from school, Eye-la heard a faint whimper coming from behind the wall of the old church.
